semantic_contract: return zero without invoking the callback when *ppos is nonzero
load the optional callback from tpd_cdev + 0xe28 and pass tpd_cdev as struct ztp_device *
preserve the stock KCFI callback type 0x73fc0d79
log the handler name and read the wake-gesture value from tpd_cdev + 0
format the unsigned value as %u\n with a ten-byte snprintf limit
copy the result through simple_read_from_buffer and preserve the stack-canary return path

evidence.raw_instruction_difference: The candidate schedules the dead v14 zero store after the *ppos branch and emits a wider local store; the device read, callback, KCFI guard, formatting and return control flow are unchanged.

follow_up_required: Review the Joern userspace_egress finding for simple_read_from_buffer against the target 6.12 ABI before hardware promotion.
Keep the dead-local store scheduling difference separate from functional parity; use an architecture-specific layout experiment only if exact byte parity becomes mandatory.
Run controlled procfs/userspace read and NX809J runtime validation only after the offline driver set is complete.
unverified: actual procfs registration, userspace fault handling and copy semantics in the target kernel
decision_basis: Ghidra pseudocode/P-Code, matching 60-instruction/240-byte body size, exact tpd_cdev + 0xe28 device offset, matching function and indirect callback KCFI types, strict Joern gate with one explicit userspace-egress finding, reproducible Docker build, and two-case two-cycle ASan/UBSan host contract.
